title: PCSX2 2.7.502: official development build
summary: PCSX2 published 2.7.502 on July 28, 2026. The release record documents an official development build for the PlayStation 2 emulator project.

blocks.text: The PCSX2 project published version 2.7.502 on July 28, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a pre-release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.
The official notes highlight the following changes: Qt: Fix logic for resetting the VM when changing discs.
